objects.description: [BRONZE BUTLER](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0060) has created forged Kerberos Ticket Granting Ticket (TGT) and Ticket Granting Service (TGS) tickets to maintain administrative access.(Citation: Secureworks BRONZE BUTLER Oct 2017)
objects.description_fa: [BRONZE BUTLER](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0060) بلیت‌های جعلی Kerberos Ticket Granting Ticket (TGT) و Ticket Granting Service (TGS) را برای حفظ دسترسی اداری ایجاد کرده است.(Citation: Secureworks BRONZE BUTLER Oct 2017)
